response.answer: Fidelity measures model accuracy, often using metrics like accuracy or precision. Stability assesses model consistency, typically via cross-validation or bootstrapping. Use estimators like ROC curves for multi-class outputs and rank methods for ranking outputs.

results.title: Discovering robust biomarkers of psychiatric disorders from ...
results.content: ## NeuroImage. Volume 319, 1 October 2025, 121422. # Review Discovering robust biomarkers of psychiatric disorders from resting-state functional MRI via graph neural networks: A systematic review. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.neuroimage.2025.121422Get rights and content. ## Highlights. A wide range of predictors and attributors have been used in existing fMRI studies. We propose a taxonomy to classify state-of-the-art GNNs customised to fMRI datasets. ## Abstract. Many recent studies have reported significant improvements in disorder classification performance via more sophisticated GNN designs and highlighted salient features that could be potential biomarkers of the disorder. Then, 65 studies using GNNs that reported potential fMRI biomarkers for psychiatric disorders (attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder, autism spectrum disorder, major depressive disorder, schizophrenia) published before 9 October 2024 were identified from 2 online databases (Scopus, PubMed). We further highlight gaps in the existing literature and put together a prediction–attribution–evaluation framework that could set the foundations for future research on discovering robust biomarkers of psychiatric disorders via GNNs. ## Graphical abstract.
